serverInfo.name: kie
serverInfo.title: kie — KIE.ai media generation
serverInfo.description: Generate images and video on KIE.ai from a desktop AI app. The KIE API key stays in the OS keystore on the user's machine; the app receives only results and local file paths. Per-task cap, daily budget and balance are checked before any request is sent.

transport.install: npm i -g @uxdata-co/kie && kie key set && kie mcp install
transport.note: Local stdio only, by design. There is no remote endpoint: a network server holding a paid media API key is the risk this project removes. `kie mcp install` registers it in Claude Desktop, the Codex app and Cursor.

tools.name: kie_credits
tools.description: Balance and today's spend against the daily budget.

tools.name: kie_models
tools.description: Curated image and video models, and the flags each one supports.

tools.name: kie_generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image, wait, download it; returns the local path plus the image inline (≤ 1.5 MB).

tools.name: kie_generate_video
tools.description: Generate a video, wait, download it. `max_credits` is required.

tools.name: kie_task_status
tools.description: Poll a task once, without downloading.

tools.name: kie_wait_task
tools.description: Wait for a task to finish, then download the result.

tools.name: kie_upload
tools.description: Upload a local file and return a temporary KIE URL for use as a reference.

authentication.note: The MCP client never handles a credential. The KIE API key is provisioned by the human with `kie key set` and read from the OS keystore by the server process. See /auth.md.
